spans.s: भिंद(दि)पाल m. 1. A small javeline thrown from the hand; 2. sling. string-instrument for throwing stones.
भिंद(दि)पाल m. 1. A small javeline thrown from the hand; 2. sling. string-instrument for throwing stones.

भिन्न (I) a. (f. न्ना) 1. Broken, torn, rent; 2. divided, separated; 3. disunited, disjoined; 4. loosened; 5. different from, other than, (with an abl., e.g. घटात्पटो भिन्नः); 6. different, varied; 7. blown, opened, expanded; 8. mingled, mixed; 9. pounded; 10. deprived of; 11. furious, in rut (as an elephant), (pp. of भिद् q.v.)
भिन्न (II) m. A defect in a jewel.
भिन्न (III) n. 1. A bit, a fragment; 2. a blossom; 3. a wound, a stab.

भिन्न (I) a. (f. न्ना) 1. Broken, torn, rent; 2. divided, separated; 3. disunited, disjoined; 4. loosened; 5. different from, other than, (with an abl., e.g. घटात्पटो भिन्नः); 6. different, varied; 7. blown, opened, expanded; 8. mingled, mixed; 9. pounded; 10. deprived of; 11. furious, in rut (as an elephant), (pp. of भिद् q.v.)
भिन्न-अंजन n. a collyrium consisting of many pounded ingredients, त्वयि तटगते स्निग्धभिन्नांजनाभे Megh.i.59, Sis.xii.68.
भिन्न-अर्थ a. perspicuous, intelligible.
भिन्न-उदर m. a half brother, i.e. one by a different mother.
भिन्न-करट m. an elephant in rut.
भिन्न-कूट a. deprived of a leader.
भिन्न-क्रम a. out of order.
भिन्न-गुणन n. multiplication of fractions.
भिन्न-घन m. the cube of a fraction.
भिन्न-प्रकार a. of a different kind.
भिन्न-भाजन n. a pot-sherd.
भिन्न-मर्मन् a. pierced in the vital parts.
भिन्न-मर्याद a. 1. unrestrained; 2. disrespectful.
भिन्न-रुचि a. having different tastes.
भिन्न-वचन n. incongruity as regards number.
भिन्न-वर्चस्, वर्चस्क a. voiding excrement.
भिन्न-वर्चस्, वर्चस्क a. voiding excrement.
भिन्न-वृत्ति a. 1. having different occupations; 2. following bad courses, leading a bad life; 3. having different feelings or inclinations, Bt.i.16.
भिन्न-संहति a. disunited.
भिन्न-स्वर a. 1. having a changed voice; 2. discordant.
भिन्न-हृदय a. pierced through the heart, बाणभिन्नहृदया निपेतुषी R.xi.19.
